Is it really free?
Yes, every game on the site is free to play and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter, you just open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my children?
We only allow family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are collected in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their own progress the same way, but clearing your browser data or using private mode will lose it all.
What are the cookie settings about?
Visitors in Europe are asked before any non-essential cookies are used. You can change your choice at any time with Cookie settings in the footer.
A game will not load. What can I do?
We can't promise a fix from here, but if it keeps happening, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com with the name of the game and we will look into it.
Where do the games come from?

There are 5 games made by Door 404, our own studio in Novi Sad, Serbia, plus games licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix. Another 6 were sent in directly by independent developers, and we never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?

Yes, submitting is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can have it removed at any time by emailing contact@ilovewebgames.com.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
You can embed our own games, which have an Embed this game box with ready-made code on their page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they do not offer embedding.
